dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharply defined posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity reflectance, showing a subtle blue-grey cast likely due to light attenuation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish pixel clusters localized near the anterior and posterior poles.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between light-grey pigmented zones and the mature white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast white linear feature is visible on the anterior dorsal plane; faint dark linear striations are present on the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint, parallel linear marks on the mid-lower dorsal plane consistent with minor epidermal abrasions.
